arguments.command:
python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Test bump_prerelease with existing prerelease
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'rc.1')
print('bump_prerelease with rc.1:', v.bump_prerelease())

# Test bump_prerelease without existing prerelease
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('bump_prerelease without prerelease:', v.bump_prerelease())
print('bump_prerelease with custom token:', v.bump_prerelease(token='dev'))

# Test bump_build with existing build
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.5')
print('bump_build with build.5:', v.bump_build())

# Test bump_build without existing build
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3)
print('bump_build without build:', v.bump_build())

# Test replace method
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build.1')
print('replace(major=2):', v.replace(major=2))
print('replace(minor=5, patch=9):', v.replace(minor=5, patch=9))
print('replace(prerelease=None):', v.replace(prerelease=None))
"
